description: A 36px icon-only button that switches between light and dark. Both icons are rendered and swapped with the dark: variant, so the right icon shows before hydration; both are aria-hidden and the button is named by its label.

screenReader.notes: The label describes the action, not the current state, so it stays correct in both themes without re-rendering. The visible icon shows the theme you will switch to (moon in light, sun in dark).

contrast.ui: The icon uses the foreground colour on the background (well above 3:1); the hover fill uses the accent token.

motion.reducedMotion: No animation; next-themes disables transitions during the switch.

consumerResponsibilities: Wrap the app in a next-themes provider with attribute="class" (ThemeProvider is exported for this).
Use className="size-11" in touch layouts such as the mobile menu for a 44px target.
